meta.name: codescan-review
meta.description: Use when reviewing source code for security issues and CodeScan MCP tools or CLI are available, especially for pre-merge diff review, repository intake, suspicious auth or input-handling code, or when a user explicitly asks for a CodeScan-based security scan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码中的安全漏洞，在合并前发现风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在代码合并前自动扫描安全漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Review source code for security issues before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically scan for security vulnerabilities before merging code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成安全代码审查员。它会用 CodeScan 工具扫描代码，找出安全漏洞（如认证、输入验证、SQL 注入等问题），并按严重程度列出结果，给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行安全审查、漏洞扫描、合并前差异审查，或代码涉及认证、密钥、输入验证等敏感逻辑时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个文件有没有安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会扫描该文件并报告安全问题。

say.text: 扫描当前分支的差异，看看有没有安全隐患。
say.note: Claude 会运行 git diff 扫描。

say.text: 审查这个仓库的代码安全性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a security code reviewer. It uses CodeScan tools to scan code for security issues (e.g., auth, input validation, SQL injection) and lists findings by severity with remediation advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a security review, vulnerability scan, pre-merge diff review, or when code involves auth, secrets, input validation, etc.

say_en.text: Review this file for security vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the file and report issues.

say_en.text: Scan the current branch diff for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude will run a git diff scan.

say_en.text: Audit this repository for security flaws.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the whole directory.
